title: Relief for Late Dispute Decisions on Post-decision Withholdings — Network Participation Agreements
content:
A dispute decision is due by its resolution due date. Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, when Cascade decides a dispute late, the practice is relieved on the first withholding that resumes recovery after that decision.

**Clause.** The decision-delay relief to the post-decision withholding ceiling is set by the days from the decision's resolution due date to its resolved date:

- more than 7 days subtracts 12 ceiling points;
- one to 7 days subtracts 6 ceiling points;
- a decision on or before its due date subtracts nothing.

## Terms

- **The decision** is the agreement's most recent dispute decision. It is read for its resolution due date and its resolved date. Where two decisions share the latest date, the one listed first on the agreement's records is taken.
- **Counting.** The due date is not counted; the resolved date is. A decision resolved on its due date is zero days late.

## Boundary table (hypothetical)

| Resolved date against the due date | Days late | Ceiling points subtracted |
|---|---|---|
| Two days before the due date | — | Nothing |
| On the due date | 0 | Nothing |
| One day after | 1 | 6 |
| Seven days after | 7 | 6 |
| Eight days after | 8 | 12 |
